purpose: Hand-painted diffuse source textures for GoldSrc/Half-Life 1 style Soviet civilian worker, packed by Blender mesh/UV asset build.

images.name: face
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: diffuse albedo texture for a low polygon Soviet civilian worker player character, 1998 GoldSrc / Half-Life 1 PC game aesthetic. Hand painted game texture, low resolution painted details, muted natural colors, flat even illumination, no physical lighting, no specular highlights, no shadows, no text, no logos, no border, no watermark. Square texture sheet, fill the whole image. A SINGLE frontal face texture to project onto a 3D man's head, NOT a photograph and NOT a rendered head. Ordinary Soviet factory worker man aged 45, tired angular face, neutral closed mouth, thin lips, slight eye bags, rough shaven dark short stubble, grey blue eyes, straight medium nose, short cropped brown grey hair and slightly receding hairline. Full front head centered facing directly forward without tilt, ears at sides. Forehead starts at y 15%, eyes y 42%, nose y 58%, mouth y 70%, chin y 85%. Skin tone muted warm tan, restrained brown grey shading deliberately painted into a flat vintage texture. Outer background same average skin tone. Readable facial features and old PC game diffuse paint, NOT cartoon, NOT a zombie, NOT uncanny photorealistic portrait, NOT a modern PBR material. No neck clothes and no perspective.
